notes: No C fixture has been compiled or executed.
R2 single-thread refusal is a safety negative only; it cannot qualify the real threaded CP3A init path.
Freeze actual r3 guard errno, state machine, lifecycle and source hashes before concrete C fixture acceptance.
Each row may expand into separately named executable cases; aggregate labels are not passed cases.
No initial-userns CAP_SYS_PTRACE grant; no production policy change; no register/return-value editing.
Harness protocol planned: /native_exit_probe active|inactive [nonce], P4NATIVE_EVENT/CHECK/GROUP JSON, explicit statuses and original PIDFD terminal facts.

cases.name: threaded_init_three_epochs
cases.setup: Create property-like sibling first; main unshare NEWNS, setns bootstrap, later setns default on one original listener/task/PIDFD; sibling stays alive.
cases.required: All three real EXIT values are 0; target ns graph changes exactly; sibling retains original namespace; each stop detaches; later call is a new ID/epoch.

cases.name: nonleader_native_unshare
cases.setup: A nonleader executes unshare while group leader and another sibling remain live; use its original PIDFD_THREAD.
cases.required: Only that nonleader is attached, observed and detached; correct userns/mntns graph; no TGID substitution.

cases.name: shared_files_native_setns
cases.setup: After native unshare splits fs, perform setns with files_struct still shared by an unrelated live sibling.
cases.required: Same held file is used at actual native fdget; real native success, no blanket files-count refusal.

cases.name: shared_fs_native_denial
cases.setup: Perform mount setns with fs_struct still actually shared.
cases.required: The original native mntns_install returns EINVAL at real EXIT; no namespace change; ARM does not replace this with arbitrary EBUSY or fabricate success.

cases.name: native_permission_denial
cases.setup: Valid same-file input, but remove target's namespace CAP_SYS_ADMIN while preserving ordinary ptrace admission.
cases.required: Real native EPERM at EXIT and unchanged graph; original result remains unchanged after detach.

cases.name: no_initial_ptrace_cap
cases.setup: Pin initial userns; record then remove SYS_PTRACE eff/prm/inh/bnd/ambient before any ARM; enter a child userns and remove its SYS_PTRACE too.
cases.required: All five initial sets lack the bit, positive parent/child ptrace relies on ordinary gates; record actual MAC labels.

cases.name: fdget_held_file_stability
cases.setup: A sharing sibling replaces the table slot after setns has captured the original file.
cases.required: If the call succeeded, it joined only the original pinned namespace; table replacement cannot redirect an already held fdget.

cases.name: wrong_notification_state
cases.setup: Unknown ID, INIT without successful RECV, different listener, stale/replied ID, missing WAIT_KILLABLE.
cases.required: Each actual state is independently established; refusal before attach; no side effect or invented coverage.

cases.name: recv_copy_lifecycle
cases.setup: Actual preflight-passing RECV copy EFAULT, and separately a held copy-in-progress window.
cases.required: ARM refuses incomplete delivery; later successful RECV on the original request can proceed. A simple EFAULT does not count as the concurrency case.

cases.name: pidfd_identity
cases.setup: Negative/closed/non-pidfs/non-thread fd, another task, leader fd for nonleader, reaped original PIDFD, bounded numeric PID reuse.
cases.required: No attach or later numeric ptrace operation can reach the replacement task.

cases.name: fixed_abi
cases.setup: Assert all offsets/24 bytes/0x40182150; nonzero flags/reserved, partial ARM buffer EFAULT, wrong ioctl size/direction.
cases.required: Exact ABI and real errno; no mutation on malformed request.

cases.name: finite_syscall_scope
cases.setup: Wrong syscall/arch/x32, unshare extra flags, setns zero/other namespace type/fd0/wide fd.
cases.required: Only the frozen native shapes accepted; compat-arch coverage requires a real compat caller, not altered userspace notification copies.

cases.name: namespace_file_identity
cases.setup: Ordinary file, wrong ns type, separately reopened same inode, another mntns, pre-ARM ADDFD replacement.
cases.required: Original struct file identity is required; a matching inode alone is insufficient.

cases.name: guard_fd_replacement
cases.setup: Hold real original setns file at ARM; sibling replaces the shared fd after SEND admission but before native fdget.
cases.required: Actual native guard mismatch error (freeze exact errno with r3), no join of substituted namespace; coverage requires observing this native branch.

cases.name: guard_closed_fd
cases.setup: Close the shared original slot before native fdget.
cases.required: Original EBADF or frozen guard error, no namespace change, guard/file ref consumed once; a later epoch cannot reuse stale pin.

cases.name: double_arm_and_replay
cases.setup: Repeat ARM on pending armed ID and SEND after reply; try next ID with old namespace pin.
cases.required: No duplicate attachment or guard; original epoch unchanged; new epoch requires fresh exact file custody.

cases.name: addfd_lifetime
cases.setup: Queue real ADDFD before ARM, cancel queued request, and attempt ADDFD after successful ARM.
cases.required: Revalidation covers queue transition; after ARM no injection through the listener. This does not stand in for shared-files native guard races.

cases.name: ptrace_permissions
cases.setup: Compare ARM with ordinary SEIZE under mismatched credentials, nondumpability, existing tracer and actual Yama/SELinux/AppArmor denials.
cases.required: No original gate bypass; each LSM denial has a real enforcing policy/label and no initial SYS_PTRACE. Existing permissive fixture policy is not coverage.

cases.name: exact_tracer_task
cases.setup: Sibling tracer thread with same visible credentials attempts armed CONTINUE.
cases.required: Refused; only original tracer TID succeeds.

cases.name: credential_generation
cases.setup: Original tracer makes a real credential-object change then restores visible values.
cases.required: Armed CONTINUE refused; retire original task, never replace authority.

cases.name: send_fabrication
cases.setup: Send error/value or malformed CONTINUE on armed notification.
cases.required: Refused; real native return comes only from actual EXIT.

cases.name: normal_ptrace_regression
cases.setup: Original ATTACH/SEIZE/TRACEME, syscall tracing, EXITKILL, normal detach.
cases.required: Original behavior/error classes unchanged; full old 160+100 suite on the new kernel still mandatory.

cases.name: tracee_exit_windows
cases.setup: Fatal tracee exit before ARM, between passes, after commit, after CONTINUE before native guard, and at EXIT.
cases.required: No UAF, leak or stale guard; task reaped by original PIDFD; no killed request receives success credit.

cases.name: tracer_thread_exitkill
cases.setup: Attaching nonleader tracer exits while sibling tracer threads remain alive.
cases.required: Original tracee dies through EXITKILL; original task actually reaped; no unrelated sibling is substituted.

cases.name: listener_loss
cases.setup: Close original listener before ARM and after ARM/CONTINUE.
cases.required: Listener-loss ENOSYS is failure of native observation; guard cleared safely; no bypass of pending same-file requirement.

cases.name: cred_guard_and_attach_races
cases.setup: Actual credential lock contention and a competing authorized attach across the two ARM passes.
cases.required: Bounded precommit refusal or one valid committed owner; no partial attachment retry or stuck locks.

cases.name: mandatory_guard_cancel
cases.setup: Cancel/unlink tracer after CONTINUE while target may enter native setns.
cases.required: No transition from mandatory guard to silently unguarded native execution; held pin or explicit failure retained until consume/exit.

cases.name: guard_non_setns_cleanup
cases.setup: No native entry due fatal exit or changed syscall path; fork-copy/exec transitions where reachable under ordinary ptrace.
cases.required: No copied guard, leaked namespace file, stale guard on later syscall, or unconditional requirement for unarmed ordinary setns.

cases.name: deadline_and_reaping
cases.setup: One absolute deadline journaled before ARM, timeout at each mutation phase; no competing generic reaper.
cases.required: Only original PIDFD kills/reaps; all task/thread terminal evidence and exact teardown deadline recorded; no numeric reacquisition.

cases.name: lockdep_and_memory
cases.setup: Admitted diagnostic kernel with real LOCKDEP/KASAN/KCSAN races when available.
cases.required: No kernel warning/UAF/lock cycle/ref leak; diagnostic evidence does not replace production-config validation.

cases.name: actual_provider_integration
cases.setup: Run frozen real host provider, not merely a fixture invoking the same ABI.
cases.required: Audit actual ptrace operation allowlist, zero SETREG/POKE/SET_SYSCALL_INFO/SYSEMU/unapproved resume, exact result passthrough, custody/phase/APEX ledger and policy.

cases.name: actual_cp3a_android
cases.setup: Boot original qualified CP3A paths with its property-service thread, APEX/native phases, app queries and later default switch.
cases.required: All real paths use new qualified kernel/provider, no permanent tracing, exact ready/phase gates, all required apps accepted.
